categories.name: Psychology
categories.description: Psychology and behavioural-science programs covering cognition, development, social behaviour, and the biological bases of the mind, offered as BA and BSc pathways at universities across Canada.

tips.title: Volunteer on a peer-support or crisis line
tips.detail: Sustained volunteering with a distress centre, crisis line, or school peer-support program is strong evidence of commitment to mental-health work and builds the listening skills psychology programs value. Many services train and accept high-school-age volunteers.

tips.title: Get research experience early
tips.detail: Helping a university or community research team, or running your own psychology experiment for a science fair, shows you understand the scientific side of the field and gives you concrete material for supplementary applications.

tips.title: Help lead a mental-health advocacy club
tips.detail: Starting or leading a student wellness or mental-health advocacy club — such as a Jack.org chapter — demonstrates initiative and a genuine interest in psychology beyond the classroom.

programs.name: Psychology

tips.title: Take the Personal Profile seriously
